title: Bartsch to Müller, 9/19 January 1630
author: Jacob Bartsch
source: Jacob Bartsch's letter to Philipp Müller written at Strasbourg on 9/19 January 1630, on his coming marriage to Kepler's daughter Susanna, the promise of a chair of mathematics at Strasbourg, and his medical doctorate. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 10. D. 4). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 97–98.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: From Strasbourg, Bartsch reports that Kepler's daughter Susanna is now living in Bernegger's house awaiting the wedding, that he has been promised a chair of mathematics, and that he will take his medical doctorate and marry at the end of February.

notes.note: The Margrave of Baden, at whose court at Durlach Susanna had been living.
Kepler, Bartsch's father-in-law to be; Bartsch's own father had died in 1628.
